fusions.name: Splash Landing
fusions.desc: Bounds to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and lands in a splash that deals 11 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ruffled
fusions.desc: Kicks an enemy and deals 4 water damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Settling Feathers
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles aside, then restore 3 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: When non-fire damage hits you, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
